description: Read one document in a wiki. Without `section`, returns the full Markdown (frontmatter stripped) plus a provenance footer. To save tokens on a long page, pass `section` (a heading title as it appears in the page body, or its slug anchor) to retrieve ONLY that section and its subsections. The Markdown may contain [[wikilinks]] to related docs — follow one by calling read_document with path "wiki/<target>.md" (drop any "#anchor" or "|label"). Exception: on a page under wiki-xl/, links whose first folder is not concepts, entities, summaries, syntheses, presentations or journal (e.g. [[reference/...]], [[guides/...]], [[history/...]]) are XL pages: use "wiki-xl/<target>.md".

path.description: Document path within the wiki, e.g. "wiki/concepts/setup.md".

section.description: Optional. A section anchor or heading title to read just that part.

name: read_document
title: Read a document
